note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: five dated air-cargo export rows from Sahar Air Cargo ACC (INBOM4) to Laos, Sri Lanka (x2), Vietnam and South Africa, all under HS 82055190 with distinct BOL numbers, latest 2026-02-25. Declared HS 820551 is consistent with the observed 82055190 (8-digit extension) — no HS correction needed. Goods are diamond-tool consumables (diamond files, press pots, UV glue) sold to diamond-processing customers, which fits the claimed aviation/transport industry label only loosely; the actual trade is diamond-tooling supply, worth flagging to the buyer. Import side also exists (suppliers DIETER BLIKLE, Werkzeugmaschinen, Germany; SAMO, Savoie Alpes Machine Outils, France), indicating a manufacturer_trader profile rather than pure trader.
